notes.title: Glass Masquerade 4: Constellations - Anounce!
notes.notes:
[p]Many of you have been asking for more stained glass puzzles - and here they are, coming in a few weeks or less. As always, thank you so much for your support over the years and the warm feedback that keeps this series going!

Based on your feedback on the last game in this series, we decided to return to the classic Tiffany-style stained glass and assembling the pieces along the glass lines. However, you will still be able to play with the board cut layouts that were introduced in the third part of the series.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845830/Glass_Masquerade_4_Constellations/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Video games to play while you're self isolating and social distancing
notes.notes:
Unless you’re in one of those international versions of Big Brother that are still going on, you’ve probably noticed that we’re in the midst of a pandemic of something called the Covid-19 virus. I can tell it’s serious because my dad’s American girlfriend isn’t allowed to visit him, which means he’s bored and phoning me in the middle of the day. Haha, I joke. But he is 70, and has a weak heart, plus he’s immunocompromised on account of catching Lyme disease from a tick once (which is exactly the sort of ridiculous thing that only happens to country dads).

If you’re anything like us, you’re now at home, staring at the walls of your living room because of this social distancing thing. But it’s not just you. In fact, all of RPS is now working from home for the foreseeable future, too. So in the spirit of camaraderie, I’ve pooled some suggestions for video games to play while we’re self-quarantining. We’ve got some multiplayer ones, some board-gamey ones, and, of course, a healthy dollop of free ones.

notes.title: Podcast: The games you might have missed in 2019 so far
notes.notes:
You can t play everything. Trust us, we ve tried. You can t even take note of all the games that come out in one week. Our mushy human brains can barely keep track of why we re standing in the dairy aisle. Was it milk we’re low on? Or butter? Yoghurt? Hang on, I’m vegan. What am I doing here?

Anyway, you re bound to have missed a few games this year. Luckily the RPS podcast, the Electronic Wireless Show, is here to mention a few puzzle games and town builders that might have flown under your radar. Let’s fire some thick opinion-bullets at them. How else are we supposed to bring them down, so you can play?

notes.title: Gettin jiggy wit it: Glass Masquerades 2 released
notes.notes:
Pretty puzzles provide peaceful piecing-together in Glass Masquerades 2: Illusions, a jigsaw puzzle game which came out last month but I’ve somehow yet to post about for RPS despite selling Alice Bee on it in the treehouse. Hello, here’s that post now. So, Glass Masquerades 2 is a jig ’em up with a ‘dark fantasy’ vibe in the vein of Tim Burton’s Alice, American McGee’s Alice, and Insane Clown Posse. Dumped with a load of odd-shaped shards of stained glass, we have to assemble them into a circular picture and the shards shimmer and glimmer and glow in a pleasing way and it’s nice, okay.

(more…)

notes.title: Patch 2.0.1-2.04
notes.notes:
[h1]First of all, we want to say GREAT THANKS for all of your support to Onyx Lute, it's SO MUCH appreciated! - we really-really tried to do our best on providing new charming glass experience for your eyes joy and pleasure despite we didn't reach everyone with how it looks and feels[/h1]

Here is a cumulative list of major changes which were introduced during the last days after release. The next patches are planned a couple of weeks later with some new QoL changes, including various monitor aspects support

[h1]Steam[/h1]
- Steam market assets are now finally live!
- Per-puzzle achievements are now granted for completing puzzles in any difficulty mode
- Added exclusive achievements for hard difficulty walkthrough, which are given for completing every arm of the illusions world map
- For both modes, achievements should be automatically granted correspondingly for already completed content when once entering the game

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
- Slightly reduced number of fragments for the first 5 puzzles
- Added an option to invert input for puzzle wheels scrolling
- Added an option to invert input for pieces rotation
- Puzzle pieces now can be rotated via A & D keyboard keys on high difficulty
- Fragments with red rings are now rotatable in high difficulty mode, however, they still have a correct rotation on initial drag to avoid guessing

[h1]Localization[/h1]
- Added Italian, Spanish & Portuguese translations
- Fixed minor localization typo-errors and world wrapping issues

[h1]Critical[/h1]
- Fixed a rare issue when save files become corrupted. For those who already have been affected by this problem, please ping to support@onyxlute.com, so we can help with restoring your progress
